_comment: New/changed labs keys from the /mobile/labs backend work. Flat dotted keys, 1:1 with labs.fr.json. Merge into lib/i18n/locales/*.json. These are ONLY the keys this change introduces — the rest of the opesDiagnostics namespace is being migrated separately, so nothing already in flight is duplicated here.
opesDiagnostics.a11y.statusUnflagged: No comparison with a usual range was given
opesDiagnostics.report.unflaggedNote: “Not recorded” means the laboratory published no usual range for that test, so this result has not been compared with one. It is not the same as a normal result.
opesDiagnostics.report.noPdfBody: The laboratory has not attached a document to this order. Everything it did release is shown above.
opesDiagnostics.request.unknownTest: That test is not on any laboratory’s published list. Choose a test from the catalogue.
opesDiagnostics.request.notAnOrder: This is a request, not a laboratory order. A clinician has to approve it before the test is carried out.
